title: User settings
description: Manage your account and personal preferences.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.publicProfileVisible: Your profile is visible to all platform visitors
privacy.publicProfileHidden: Only your name, username and avatar is visible to other users
privacy.emailVisible: Your email is visible to all platform visitors
privacy.emailHidden: Your email is visible only to you

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.enableAllDescription: Enable or disable all notification types at once
notifications.projectDescription: Get notified about activity related to projects you follow or participate in
notifications.participationRequestsDescription: Get notified when someone wants to join your project
notifications.commentsDescription: Get notified when someone comments on your projects or replies to your comments
notifications.conversationsDescription: Get notified about new messages and activity in your conversations
notifications.reportsDescription: Get notified about updates to reports you have submitted
notifications.otherDescription: Receive notifications about important platform activity that doesn't belong to any other notification category.
